summary: Iteration-3 backend regression mostly passed: startup health, auth/roles, doctor search, legal/API checks, reminder creation, cancellation lock cleanup, and rebooking succeeded. Mobile direct login/dashboard also loaded, but the landing sign-in control is hidden at mobile width.

minor.issue: Legacy test reused a slot already booked by the prior run and received [409,409]; the new booking/cancellation/rebooking flow passed. Test data is not isolated or cleaned up.

ui_bugs.issue: Mobile CSS hides the Sign in button together with desktop landing links, leaving Book an appointment as the only entry point.

action_items: Keep a visible sign-in action on mobile landing navigation.
Make concurrency regression data unique per run or clean up created appointments before rerun.
critical_code_review_comments: Reminder records are correctly persisted and public appointment responses exclude _id; no new startup or ObjectId leakage issue found.
seed_data_creation: No users created. Created test appointments/reminders and a cancellation/rebooking record using existing patient5 and demo doctor data; existing prior test artifacts remain in the database.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Health/auth/legal/doctor search and reminder/cancel/rebook were exercised. Recheck mobile landing sign-in and rerun concurrency with isolated appointment data. Google OAuth was not exercised.
rca of the issue: The mobile media query hides .landing-links a and .landing-links .text-button, which removes the sign-in button at widths <=850px. The concurrency failure is test contamination: iteration-2 uses a fixed doctor/date/time and leaves the successful appointment, so a later run sees both requests as conflicts.
